checks: fresh heartbeat uses half-hour schedule and is created once
upgrade updates old defaults and preserves pause and custom scheduling
due job queues a bounded investigation with timezone, private context boundaries and alert history
an in-flight investigation cannot queue a second turn
rolling lookback survives failures, partial reads and indexing delays
a targetless delivery is not marked as alerted and the next check can retry
an accepted finding reaches memory once; whitespace duplicates and NOTHING stay quiet
proactive findings use the existing quiet-hours admission path
a successfully queued WhatsApp alert is recorded after acceptance
a failed transport leaves no deduplication marker and the next check can retry
duplicate suppression survives a runtime restart
truncated alert memory never suppresses a materially different long finding
model: fixture output; no model or live accounts
